title: Hannah F NDE 7202
content: When I was 16, I was in a bad place mentally and physically. I did drugs frequently and did not eat much. I was living in poverty, unsure of anything. In the midst of my reckless lifestyle, I began to consider God. I prayed frequently and read the bible a lot. I had a massive curiosity with God and Jesus. I learned as much about God as I could. During this time, for a few days, I had not eaten anything. I would say two or three days. I was in the shower when I started to feel dizzy. I knew I was going to faint. I swayed backwards and forwards. The next thing I recall is sitting on a massive stone talking to a man. There was a waterfall in front of us and beautiful scenery. I would probably call it a beautiful garden. However, everything was natural. I remember a feeling of love and reassurance. I don't remember what the man was telling me, but he was speaking for a long time. It felt like hours. I remember being shocked at a few things he said. Now, in my experience, I was ME but I wasn't 'HANNAH'. I knew myself, but not as Hannah. I don't remember what was spoken but I remember the feelings I felt. All I remember him saying was, 'It's time to go back now.' I looked at him puzzled, not remembering earth, and then felt a pain on my shoulder. When I felt the pain, I began to travel through a tunnel. As I went down the tunnel, I could see images of my life and my life on earth came back to me. I woke up with my boyfriend calling my name and a burn on my shoulder. The hot water tap in the shower leaked hot water and I had been against it while unconscious. I was dazed and confused for a while. My OBE slowly came back to me. As I don't remember what the man said, (who I feel was Jesus), and I wasn't earthly me in my 'experience', I don't feel that what was spoken to me is relevant to my earthly journey. I have taken from my experience, that there is a much bigger part of us that a lot of us are not aware. Jesus/God emits feelings of love and peace, and near them is where our home really is. I honestly am not afraid of death. I do, however, want to live on earth. Also that pain is the best reminder of earth.

environment.environment_other_detail: Sitting on a massive stone with a waterfall in front; beautiful natural scenery like a garden.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fainted in the shower after not eating for 2–3 days (starvation/weakness) with drug use mentioned as background.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Bible reading; interest in God and Jesus.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: She first found herself in a garden-like setting talking with a man; only later, after shoulder pain, she traveled through a tunnel with images of her life and then woke in her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reports being herself but not 'Hannah' (identity not tied to earthly name) until tunnel images restored memory of Earth; shoulder pain triggered the return/tunnel and corresponded to an actual burn from hot water.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “In my experience, I was ME but I wasn't 'HANNAH'.” / “It's time to go back now.” / “Jesus/God emits feelings of love and peace, and near them is where our home really is.” / “Also that pain is the best reminder of earth.”
